title: File:View of the West Side of Porto Ferrajo Bay Elba engraved by Francis Jukes after James Weir RM - UK BM 86050700.jpg
description:
Island of Elba with four interesting views of the capital. View of the West Side of Porto Ferrajo Bay

Print after Major James Weir
republished state. 1799, this state 1814. Colour etching and aquatint with additional hand-colouring.
Additional Makers: Publisher - James Daniell; Print maker - Francis Jukes

Inscription: 'James Weir' to 'the Right Honble Earl Spencer' and 'With the positions of the Captain 74. - Flora, Inconstant, Southampton Frigates. / Drawn by Capt.n James Weir. / Engraved by F. Jukes. / London, Pub.d by Ja.s Daniell, 480, Strand, April, 1814'
